author: mark
text:
provider: retire --endpoint argv; describe-driven endpoint discovery

The harness no longer reads or interprets endpoint URLs. The adapter
declares one or more env var names in describe.endpoint_env; the
harness sets each to providers.<name>.endpoint before invoking
complete. The --endpoint argv flag is gone and the contract version
bumps to 2.

Restores ARCH §4.4's strict separation ("the harness itself does not
read endpoint:") and retires the v0.1 (b) pragma in §12.
